title: vic.ceo: Vic's builder bio, from a $75 game gig to selling multiple software products
summary: Vic's personal homepage lists his track record: indie games, a dev agency turned software studio, and several products built and sold (Affistash, BrowserUnicorn, Coverposts, PodKit). He is open about failed products too. It is a bio, not a how-to, so it offers little tactical insight.

principles.text: Start small and early: a first tiny paid gig can set the whole trajectory.
principles.quote: my life changed at 13 when i made $75 from a game dev gig

principles.text: Build products and sell them: repeated small exits beat waiting on one big outcome.
principles.quote: Built [PodKit](https://podk.it) and sold it in 3 months to [listener.com](https://listener.com) w/ericmelchor

principles.text: Services can be a bridge: turn an agency into a studio that launches its own SaaS.
principles.quote: turned that software agency into a [software studio](https://developmently.org) and launched SaaS products. Some were successful, some were not

principles.text: Ship many bets and be honest about the failures.
